description: Get the structure (Data Structure Definition) of one STATEC dataset: its ordered dimensions and, for each, the valid codes. Use this BEFORE get_data to learn how to build the dot-separated SDMX `key`. The key has one position per dimension, in `dimension_order`; an empty position is a wildcard. Example: dataflow_structure({ dataflow_id: "DF_A1100" }).

dataflow_id.description: STATEC dataflow id from list_dataflows, e.g. "DF_A1100".

name: dataflow_structure
title: Dataflow Structure
